messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thank you, John. I can see your line (555-123-2002) is active and roaming is enabled on our side, which is good for your situation in France.

Since you can make calls and browse the web but MMS isn't sending, this is likely a device configuration issue. Let's start by checking your APN settings, as incorrect MMSC (Multimedia Messaging Service Center) settings are a very common cause of MMS issues, especially when roaming.

Please check your APN settings by using the **check_apn_settings** action on your phone. What does it show for the APN name and MMSC URL?

The APN name on my phone is set to "internet," but it shows that the MMSC URL, which is for picture messages, is not set at all. What should I do next? Will this fix my MMS problem?

Please process the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
